debates.rationale: CPI inflation surprise indicates persistent price pressures, triggering hawkish Fed response. This supports higher-for-longer rate expectations and reinforces inflation-fighting stance. Positive bias reflects heightened tightening cycle risk.
CPI surprise to the upside forces Fed into hawkish stance, reducing near-term easing probability. Inflation concerns dominate growth slowdown narrative. Dovish positioning weakened significantly.

Hawkish Fed pivot from inflation surprise typically strengthens USD, pressuring XAUUSD downward (-), but stagflationary concerns support safe-haven gold demand (+). USOIL benefits from inflation expectations and potential supply tightening, offsetting near-term demand destruction. Net effect: mild bullish bias for commodities as inflation expectations rise despite rate hike expectations.
